posts.t: It's a goal. Initial shot went off the post, then bounced off Woll's skate and just barely trickled over the line. Sanheim tried to save it but was a bit late. It was very close, though, about as close as it gets. 2-2.
Sanheim to Martone, and it's 2-0. What a swing that McDonald fight/chaos was. (Also a hell of a pass by Sanheim.)

Suspect what you'll see with Ristolainen back is Bonk will get his minutes cut a bit -- wouldn't be surprised to see Risto take some shifts with Sanheim, particularly on d-zone starts -- but they clearly (and rightfully) like what the Sanheim-Bonk pair has provided so far.

threads.t: PORTER. MARTONE. What a pass by Sanheim (Zegras another assist 😂) & a huge shout-out to McDonald who drew BOTH penalties!
